body.x: Macally showed new accessories for smart devices at CES 2012 held from Jan 10~13, n Las Vegas, USA.

Macally is located at ‘iLounge’ the place for highlight products ofr this exhibition, they designed booth with their new C.I (Coporate Identity) applied from 2012. Also, total 40 kinds of products are exhibited including iPhone/iPad accessory, PC/Notebook accessory.
In particular, folding iPhone stand and Dock for iPad, shown at first at this exhibition, feature Macally's own unique functionality. Country-by-country, all different type codes can be used.
Three pieces Universal design power adapters equipped with USB port are opened, also cup holder for car and iPhone holder to attach on car window are shown .
Cases for iPhone 4S released at the end of las year drew attentions, especially spring type pop up holder 'Pop Up' and charging stand were the famous products at CES 2012.
Above these, 'Splitter' product family which can use three earphones at once with one AUX terminal, and Macally brand notebook bag are also introduced.
